impacts.description: Achievement of European open strategic autonomy in digital and emerging enabling technologies through next-generation AI agent research and innovation.
Contribution to the Apply AI Strategy through research results on next-generation AI agents for real-world sector applications.
Economic benefit through targeted deployment of AI agent technologies in high-value application sectors including healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving.
impacts.inference_note: The portfolio coverage procedure requires at least one funded project per each of the three named sectors (healthcare, advanced manufacturing, in-vehicle autonomous driving). This sector selection priority implies an expected economic impact in those sectors through AI deployment; the sector focus is confirmed but the framing as an expected economic impact is derived by inference from the sector coverage mandate rather than an explicitly labelled expected impacts section.

impacts.description: Strengthening of the European AI R&D community through open sharing of communicable results via the AI-on-demand platform and linkage to AI Factories and Data Labs.
Broader societal deployment and uptake of AI agent technologies through validation in Testing and Experiment Facilities and further deployment via European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs).
